reference.pr_view_reviews: mr approvals <iid> for assigned reviewers and current approval summary; existing mr discussions <iid> for threaded/inline notes, not GitHub review submissions

operations.name: issue-discussions
operations.empty: complete empty array, never inferred from a provider error

operations.name: mr-approvals
operations.reviewers: mr-view reviewers are assigned users, not submitted reviews or approvals
operations.state: approved and not_approved only from an explicit provider approved boolean; missing/null is unknown, never inferred from approvals_left or approved_by
operations.unavailable: only a definite HTTP 403 or 404 on approvals becomes unavailable with incomplete metadata; authentication, cancellation and all other errors fail
operations.tier: unknown: edition, license and rule availability cannot be inferred from approval counts, HTTP 403 or HTTP 404
operations.limit_unit: each embedded user array; validate all records before trimming
operations.rules: not exposed: the shipped official mr-view internally attempts approval_state and tolerates failure; this command never interprets that as approval or tier evidence. Explicit approvals GET supplies the summary.

guarantees: exact host/project/global ID/IID and canonical resource URL binding
MR source/target projects, branches and base/head snapshot binding reused from discussions
identity rechecked after collection; observational window, not an atomic or merge-authorization receipt
no provider mutation, credential change, arbitrary API surface or native-v1/default-view schema change
